quickPrompts.zh: 接手这份半成品，先核实版本和已定事项，再把审核过的成品交回这里。
quickPrompts.en: Take over this draft. Confirm its version and the decisions already made, then return the reviewed deliverable here.

quickPrompts.zh: 从这个目标开始，把我的要求做成一份能直接使用的成品。
quickPrompts.en: Start from this goal and return a deliverable I can use.

quickPrompts.zh: 要求有变化。请继续原项目，保留已经通过的部分，让受影响的内容得到复核。
quickPrompts.en: Continue the project with my revised requirements. Preserve approved work and recheck the affected parts.

displayDescription.zh: 接手未完成的项目，按要求制作成品，途中变更只更新受影响部分，由独立审核席核准后交回原会话。
displayDescription.en: Start a project or hand over a draft. The team makes the deliverable, checks the actual file and returns the reviewed version in this chat.

description: A three-role team that takes projects from a goal or an unfinished draft through production and independent review to delivery.
